column11: Semi-autonomous county parks district created September 1, 1992 by Ottawa County Probate Court under ORC. Five-member Board of Park Commissioners; county-wide levy passed 2020. Primary functions: grants to municipal/township parks; directly manages the North Coast Inland Trail (CROSS_COUNTY_CANDIDATE, T3), Portage River Water Trail (KNOWN_MC:OH-MC-TR-002), and Catawba Islander Trail (PLANNED, T4). Acts primarily as a grants body — does not own individual parks/sites directly. Listed as Ottawa County department on co.ottawa.oh.us/197/Departments.
column12: Alternate names: Ottawa County Parks District; Ottawa County Parks. Staged as Site Network per §4.5 (formal county parks district). Confirmed T3 via Ohio Auditor. Source date: 2026-05-18.

column11: Ohio's only National Wildlife Refuge Complex, formally designated by USFWS. Ohio members include Ottawa NWR (Ottawa County), Cedar Point NWR (Lucas County), and West Sister Island NWR (Lucas County). Schoonover Waterfowl Production Area in Michigan is administratively part of the complex but is out of Ohio scope.
column12: USFWS formally designates this as the 'Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge Complex' — Ohio's only NWR complex. Spans Ottawa and Lucas counties. Schoonover WPA (Michigan) out of Ohio scope. Condition B MC ID assigned: OH-MC-SN-0002.
